edges.reason: msg.sender is supplied as the mint recipient inside batchMint.
msg.sender is forwarded as the receiver into the onERC721Received external callback.
batchMint calls _safeMint which invokes onERC721Received on a contract recipient, allowing reentrancy before state is finalized.
safeMint calls _safeMint which invokes onERC721Received on a contract recipient.
withdrawAll performs an external ether transfer via send, transferring control to the owner.
batchMint enforces the tokenId <= totalSupply cap.
safeMint enforces the tokenId <= totalSupply cap.
batchMint computes basePrice * count for the payment requirement.
safeMint compares msg.value against basePrice.
batchMint reads and increments _tokenIdCounter for each minted token.
safeMint reads and increments _tokenIdCounter.
isApprovedForAll queries ProxyRegistry at proxyRegistryAddress.
initialize writes proxyRegistryAddress.
initialize writes basePrice.
initialize writes totalSupply.
count parameter controls the loop bound and the payment multiplication in batchMint.
to parameter is the mint recipient in safeMint.
tokenId_local is derived from the counter and passed to _safeMint in safeMint.
amount_local captures the contract balance that is sent out in withdrawAll.
_authorizeUpgrade (onlyOwner) guards the delegatecall-based upgrade path.

normalization_plan.reason: The count parameter only has meaning as the loop bound and payment multiplier of batchMint; collapse it into that function.
The to parameter is solely the mint recipient argument of safeMint and carries no independent semantics.
The local tokenId value is derived from _tokenIdCounter and immediately consumed by _safeMint inside safeMint.
The local amount value only exists to feed the send call inside withdrawAll.
